verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support: Capacities has a block-based editor whose blocks can be linked and embedded across objects, templates can prefill blocks, and images become reusable image objects that can be placed anywhere, which a user describes as Notion-like. Missing for 10: any documentation of headings, callouts, tables, or code blocks; evidence of embedding media beyond images; evidence of keyboard-driven editing or slash commands; and any proof of editor speed or hands-on corroboration.
